title: Chapter 1218 - 29: Inconceivable Prestige (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1218 - 29: Inconceivable Prestige (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1218: Chapter 29: Inconceivable Prestige (Seeking Subscription)_2

"To force Fu Xu Venerate to relinquish the gigantic core pillar... how is this possible?"

The hearts of several Peak Venerables were shaken. The original battle fluctuations over by the gigantic core pillar had already left them astounded.

Now even the gigantic core pillar has changed hands.

Given the importance of the gigantic core pillar, Fu Xu Venerate couldn’t possibly have not descended. Since he descended and it still changes hands, it means Fu Xu Venerate voluntarily gave way.

"It is Galaxy Venerate, that gigantic core pillar has been refined by Galaxy Venerate."

"Galaxy Venerate? Isn’t he just newly entered into the Heavenly Venerable Realm?"

"Galaxy Venerate took the gigantic core pillar from Fu Xu Venerate?"

The many Peak Venerables were a bit dumbfounded. They had anticipated that other Ancient Countries might deliberately hide a powerful one, but didn’t expect this powerful one to be Galaxy Venerate?

The uniqueness of Galaxy Venerate is singular across the six Ancient Countries; he is the first royal clan member to elevate the ancestors’ bloodline to the Heavenly Venerate level.

But time has been too short. For royals, tapping into the Bloodline Power makes it indeed easier to ascend in strength, but only relatively easier, not a leap to the top.

"Is this the ancestral bloodline at the Heavenly Venerate level?" Many Peak Venerables’ thoughts were diffused, already planning to study the ancestral bloodline thoroughly after this treasure land’s power struggle concludes.

Before Lin Yuan, truly powerful Peak Venerables somewhat looked down on Bloodline Power and its limitations.

But now?

The numerous Peak Venerables had no more stereotypes about the ancestral bloodline.

...

The mysterious and ancient capital of Da Fu nation, this is the first city of this source world and also the birthplace of the first Da Fu Ancestor, holding great significance not only for Da Fu Ancient Country but also for the other five Ancient Countries. It’s the wellspring of everything.

Even if among the five ancestors, three were not born in Da Fu Ancient Country, but to become ancestors is deeply tied to the Da Fu Ancestor.

After all, the path of cultivation and the cultivation system of this world originated from the Da Fu Ancestor.

In the deepest part of the capital.

Several figures gathered here.

Nearby, scenes are flashing past, showing Lin Yuan punching through the eleven Peak Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country and finally taking on a strike from Fu Xu Venerate.

Fu Xu Venerate was also among them, quietly observing the passing images, occasionally lost in thought.

"Tsk tsk, this Galaxy Venerate, his methods are remarkable, the path of Chaos Power he evolved is very unusual."

"Indeed, I can see he should have cultivated a thirteenth-level legacy, but to withstand Fu Xu’s full-force strike relied mainly on his self-evolved path of Chaos Power."

"Such a strong path of Chaos Power, very rare."

Each figure spoke in turn, evaluating Galaxy Venerate.

"A thirteenth-level legacy, plus the Heavenly Venerate level of ancestral bloodline power, along with an extraordinary path of Chaos Evolution, this Galaxy Venerate, still has considerable room for growth."

"Indeed, if another thirteenth-level legacy is mastered, we estimate we would not be his match without joining forces."

The figures exchanged words, highly praising Lin Yuan.

"The path of Chaos Power evolved by this Galaxy Venerate seems not yet to have reached the third tier, lacking that sense of perfection." At this moment, a previously silent voice suddenly spoke.

"Not yet reached the third tier in the evolution of the path of Chaos Power?" Hearing this, the expressions of the other figures slightly shifted.

The evolutionary paths of Chaos Power are divided into three levels, with significant differences, particularly between the second tier and the third tier, representing the gap from an ordinary Heavenly Venerate to a Peak Venerable and even a top Peak Venerable.

"Fu Xu, you’ve fought him, is it so?" A figure looked toward Fu Xu Venerate and inquired.

The images passing by are, after all, just images, even if sourced from Fu Xu Venerate’s memory, they aren’t comparable to personally being present.

"Yes."

Fu Xu Venerate remained silent for a while, then nodded.

The third tier of the Chaos evolutionary path is the realm of perfection. Achieving this level of an evolutionary path would give a sense of having reached the ultimate, unprogressable limit.

And in this regard, Fu Xu Venerate had not felt that from the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Diagram evolved by Galaxy Venerate.

"Could it be that in this era, our six Ancient Countries will see the birth of a mighty figure who surpasses the Strongest Venerable?"

One figure couldn’t help but say.

Since the founding of the six Ancient Countries, the Strongest Venerable has always been the pinnacle of the Heavenly Venerate level, yet with the current power exhibited by Galaxy Venerate, it’s highly possible to break this limit.

"Hehe, don’t say such things; the stronger the Chaos evolutionary power path is, the more challenging it is to reach perfection."

Another figure spoke without much worry, "Besides, even if Galaxy Venerate truly reaches that step, what impact does he have on us?"

"Not reaching the ancestral level, could he threaten our Da Fu Ancient Country? And if he does reach the ancestral level, then it’s a matter for the ancestors to consider, unrelated to us."

With these words pronounced.

The other figures pondered for a moment and immediately nodded in agreement.

"Ancestral level huh, don’t know if any of us have a hope to step into it..."

The figures’ thoughts spread out, as for the Heavenly Venerate, the loftiest desire is to break the cycle of time, stepping into the thirteenth-tier ancestral realm.

However, it’s extremely difficult; since Da Fu Ancestor founded Da Fu Ancient Country, only five ancestors have been born in endless aeons.

The figures present are the strongest venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country, having incarnated as ancestors more than once, and the more they incarnate, the more they perceive the disparity between the ancestors and themselves.

This disparity is not merely a level of power, but a higher tier of distance.

"That Galaxy Venerate, no matter how strong, whether he can ultimately become an ancestor is still uncertain, his likelihood isn’t much higher than ours." a figure spoke.

...

"Fu Xu, do you have confidence in this treasure land’s power struggle?"

A few figures chatted casually for a while, then looked toward Fu Xu Venerate.

Initially, Da Fu Ancient Country dispatched Fu Xu Venerate, the strongest venerate, to contend for that treasure land, and it was as close to victory as possible; they just didn’t expect Galaxy Venerate to appear.

"Conventional methods can’t deal with that Galaxy Venerate, but in a real life-and-death showdown, the current Galaxy Venerate may not necessarily be my match."

Fu Xu Venerate said.

Perhaps in the future, Galaxy Venerate’s power will surpass his, but now?

The reason Fu Xu Venerate voluntarily yielded the gigantic core pillar was not out of fear of Galaxy Venerate, but to avoid letting other Ancient Countries reap the benefits, and with almost a thousand years until the power struggle for treasure land begins, Da Fu Ancient Country still holds advantages, etc.

It was not out of fear of that Galaxy Venerate.

"That’s good."

"What a pity, had I known such a formidable Galaxy Venerate would emerge in this treasure land power struggle, I would have participated."

The figures conversed mutually, at their level, dueling with peers of the same level is also a delight.

...

Inside the treasure land.

Outside the gigantic core pillar.

The eleven Peak Venerables of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country arrived there.

"Galaxy Venerate... can Galaxy Venerate really reclaim this gigantic pillar?" Up till now, Venerable Guanglie still found it hard to believe.

As a top Peak Venerable, he deeply understood Fu Xu Venerate’s might. Even for him, it would require the fierce ancient country’s foundational killing artefact to contend with him.

If Fu Xu Venerate also wielded the foundational killing artefact, then joint forces from other Ancient Countries would be needed to counter him.

This is a scene inevitably appearing in the later stages of the treasure land’s power struggle, given Da Fu Ancient Country’s might.

"Galaxy Venerate’s power... is too strong."

Venerable Hengyang remarked with emotion, recalling when the entry quota for the treasure land was being determined; he was slightly displeased with the emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country forcing in this royal member.

"Alright."

At this point, Red Flame Venerable finally spoke, "Galaxy is letting us in."

"Hmm."

The other Peak Venerables nodded.

At present, the leading venerate of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country had quietly shifted from Red Flame Venerable to Galaxy Venerate.

There was no other choice.

In all six Ancient Countries, strength reigns supreme, a stern rule. Galaxy Venerate has been acknowledged as having the power of the strongest venerate; if he’s not the leader, who is? If Red Flame Venerable leads, so does Galaxy Venerate.

Moreover, Galaxy Venerate seizing the gigantic core pillar holds immense significance for this treasure land power struggle.

It alleviated the pressure on the Fierce Sun Ancient Country in taking more core pillars in the subsequent stages.

The strength is present; the merit follows.

If Galaxy Venerate isn’t the leading venerate, who is?
